ask_runs_principal_check.name: ask_runs_principal_check
ask_runs_principal_check.value:
("app"."ask_runs"."principal_type" = 'user' and "app"."ask_runs"."user_id" is not null and "app"."ask_runs"."service_key_id" is null)
				or ("app"."ask_runs"."principal_type" = 'service_key' and "app"."ask_runs"."user_id" is null and "app"."ask_runs"."service_key_id" is not null and "app"."ask_runs"."thread_id" is null)

ask_runs_terminal_check.name: ask_runs_terminal_check
ask_runs_terminal_check.value:
("app"."ask_runs"."status" = 'running' and "app"."ask_runs"."ended_at" is null and "app"."ask_runs"."latency_ms" is null)
				or ("app"."ask_runs"."status" <> 'running' and "app"."ask_runs"."ended_at" is not null and "app"."ask_runs"."latency_ms" is not null)

ask_runs_refusal_check.name: ask_runs_refusal_check
ask_runs_refusal_check.value:
("app"."ask_runs"."status" = 'refused' and "app"."ask_runs"."refuse_reason" is not null)
				or ("app"."ask_runs"."status" <> 'refused' and "app"."ask_runs"."refuse_reason" is null)

jobs_progress_check.name: jobs_progress_check
jobs_progress_check.value:
"app"."jobs"."progress" between 0 and 100
				and "app"."jobs"."attempt" >= 0
				and "app"."jobs"."max_attempts" > 0
				and ("app"."jobs"."progress_current" is null or "app"."jobs"."progress_current" >= 0)
				and ("app"."jobs"."progress_total" is null or "app"."jobs"."progress_total" >= 0)
				and ("app"."jobs"."progress_current" is null or "app"."jobs"."progress_total" is null or "app"."jobs"."progress_current" <= "app"."jobs"."progress_total")
